description: Shows an EARLIER aicut generation to the user again, in the aicut card: the video, image or audio itself, with what it cost and when it was made. WHEN: the user asks to see something they already have (from earlier in this conversation, or found with `list_videos` / `list_images` / `list_audio`): that is its only job. Each `generate_*` already put the card up on the call that started the job, so calling this after one adds a duplicate: never call it per wait or twice for the same id in one turn. Call it on a finished job (a card for a `queued` or `processing` job is an empty placeholder). THE ONE EXCEPTION is an AI Video Story episode parked at frame review (`media: "video"`, the id from `generate_story_video`): the card replays the per-scene frames grid, which is how you bring an episode's frames back. Where the card renders it IS the answer: add one short line and do not paste the job id or JSON. No card on your client (a terminal)? Give the user the `url` from this result. Spends no tokens, creates nothing.

id.description: A job id from a `generate_*` tool or transform, or an episode id from `generate_story_video` (media `video`).

media.description: Which kind of generation the id belongs to: `video` (a `generate_video` job, any video transform: `upscale_video`, `extend_video`, `edit_video`, `motion_control`, `generate_lipsync`, and a story render; an AI Video Story episode is a `video`), `image` (including `upscale_image`) or `audio`.

name: show_generation
title: Show an earlier generation again
